frontiers.name: Challenge
frontiers.change: Retire a claim under a declared test

frontiers.name: Alternatives
frontiers.change: Change the live partition without dropping a material rival

frontiers.name: Decision
frontiers.change: License a commitment under an explicit standard

frontiers.name: Frame
frontiers.change: Fix the object, scope, and acceptance predicate

frontiers.name: Representation
frontiers.change: Expose a distinction without losing an existing one

frontiers.name: Reasoning
frontiers.change: Derive a claim with inspectable dependencies and a possible defeat

frontiers.name: Evidence
frontiers.change: Change a warranted belief with an auditable observation

frontiers.name: Control
frontiers.change: Keep work inside an authority and resource envelope

frontiers.name: Action
frontiers.change: Change the world with explicit trial, acceptance, and effect bounds

frontiers.name: State
frontiers.change: Repair affected state and invalidate only dependent claims

frontiers.name: Verification
frontiers.change: Match the checked property to the exact claim and retain an inspectable witness

frontiers.name: Closure
frontiers.change: Close with a checked condition and a defined reopen trigger

parametric_additions.change: Group live hypotheses by the acceptable actions they permit
parametric_additions.bind: Hypotheses, requirements, and acceptable-action set for each hypothesis
parametric_additions.failure: Shared action assumed without checking every live class

parametric_additions.change: Expose the smallest contradictory subset of formal requirements
parametric_additions.bind: Formalized constraints and a solver or checkable derivation
parametric_additions.failure: Informal disagreement mislabeled a formal inconsistency

parametric_additions.change: Compare the value of an observation with acting now
parametric_additions.bind: Actions, outcome model, probability or bounded uncertainty, utility and probe cost
parametric_additions.failure: A numerical estimate invented without a governing model

parametric_additions.change: Split a coarse class when a real counterexample shows it hides a needed distinction
parametric_additions.bind: Abstraction relation, counterexample, and preserved invariant
parametric_additions.failure: A new representation breaks an already established result

parametric_additions.change: Expose shared dependencies whose failure would defeat several derivations
parametric_additions.bind: Dependency graph, failure hypotheses, and a separating observation
parametric_additions.failure: Nominally independent answers share the same unsupported premise

parametric_additions.change: Bound repeated evidence collection with precommitted continuation and stop rules
parametric_additions.bind: Observation process, error targets, stopping rule, and decision threshold
parametric_additions.failure: Threshold changed after seeing interim results

parametric_additions.change: Track correlated observations and the claims that depend on them
parametric_additions.bind: Raw observations, acquisition methods, and dependency edges
parametric_additions.failure: Several copies of one source counted as independent confirmation

parametric_additions.change: Permit a common action across unresolved live states
parametric_additions.bind: Live states, admissible actions, protected constraints, and common acceptance
parametric_additions.failure: One live state makes the proposed action unsafe

parametric_additions.change: Reconcile planned, attempted, and observed external effects
parametric_additions.bind: Target revision, action identifier, tool receipt, and side effects
parametric_additions.failure: A retry duplicates an ambiguous external effect

parametric_additions.change: Reopen only results dependent on the changed basis
parametric_additions.bind: Versioned dependency edges and exact source or contract change
parametric_additions.failure: An unrelated verified result is discarded or a dependent one survives

parametric_additions.change: Test whether a checker shares the failure it is meant to catch
parametric_additions.bind: Claim, checker implementation, common failure hypotheses, and independent probe
parametric_additions.failure: Generated claim and generated checker agree for the same wrong reason

parametric_additions.change: Close a request when a checked acceptable result persists across live rivals
parametric_additions.bind: All live classes, common accepted output, residue, and reopen condition
parametric_additions.failure: A live rival changes the required output
